bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 10 日均线，$219 附近受阻

read.en: Coherent rose 0.9% on Nov 18 to $212.84, trading $204.78–219.06 on light volume (0.64x the 20-day average). It held above the rising 10-day ($211.4) but is below the rising 5-day ($215.5) and the falling 30-day ($230.7), 100-day ($281.9) and 200-day ($296.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($178.25), and RSI is 45.2.
read.zh: Coherent 11月18日上涨 0.9%，收于 $212.84，盘中区间 $204.78–219.06，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.64 倍）。股价守在上行的 10 日均线（$211.4）上方，但低于上行的 5 日均线（$215.5）以及下行的 30 日（$230.7）、100 日（$281.9）和 200 日均线（$296.6）。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$178.25），RSI 为 45.2。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $219.06 high poked above $214.7–218.2 but the close fell back under it, and the $204.78 low held above $200.5. Resistance is $214.7–219.1 (5-day, Nov 18 high), then $220.7–225.2 and $230.7–234.5 (30-day, Nov 12 and 11 closes). Support is $207.1–211.4 (10-day, Nov 10 and 13 lows), then $200.5–204.8 and $196. A close above $219.1 would target $225; below $207, $200.5.
